title: Chicago Alt.NET: Mike Hall Interviews Sergio Pereira | SCNA 2011

people.name: Sergio Pereira
people.role: Featured Guest (Founder & Organizer, Chicago Alt.NET; SCM Manifesto Signatory #592; Chicago Code Camp ccs Contributor)

people.name: Mike Hall
people.role: Interviewer / Host (UGtastic Creator; SCM Manifesto Signatory #106; Chicago Code Camp Co-Organizer)

foundational_concepts: Cross-Platform Pollination (NHibernate, NHaml, Spark, IronRuby, CodeSharp, Kanban)
dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: Recorded November 19, 2011 at the inaugural era of UGtastic at SCNA 2011 (Swissotel Chicago) using Photo Booth.app on a 15-inch unibody MacBook Pro. Captures four years of Chicago Alt.NET (founded late 2007 after David Laribee's April 2007 Alt.NET Manifesto and the October 2007 Austin Alt.NET Open Spaces), meeting on the second Wednesday at 6:30 PM at Redpoint Technologies in the Sears (Willis) Tower, where Mike Hall attended his first Chicago Alt.NET meeting (August 13, 2008) and gave his first user group talk on NHaml alongside Adam Tybor on Spark (November 12, 2008).
dimensions.subsequent_history_and_trajectory: Alt.NET's grassroots push for testability, open-source tooling, and MVC architecture reshaped the Microsoft ecosystem (ASP.NET MVC, jQuery in Visual Studio, NuGet, and later cross-platform .NET Core). Forensic archival recovery confirmed Sergio Pereira as Software Craftsmanship Manifesto Signatory #592 (Grayslake, IL) and the #2 code contributor (24 commits in Ruby, Haml, and Sass) to the just3ws/ccs Rails 3.0 application that powered Chicago Code Camp (2010-2012), where he also spoke in May 2012.
